findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "save_recipe" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use when the user explicitly asks to save a complete recipe privately. Include realistic integer prep_time_minutes, cook_time_minutes, and total_time_minutes va…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: attach_instruction_image · Private data: prepare_meal_plan_import, commit_meal_plan_import, list_saved_recipes, list_saved_meal_plans, show_meal_plan, open_recipebee_kitchen, attach_instruction_image, update_recipe_content, show_recipe, attach_recipe_image, generate_recipe_image, get_recipe_image · Public sink: commit_meal_plan_import, attach_instruction_image, update_recipe_content, save_recipe · Destructive: remove_instruction_image, attach_recipe_image, generate_recipe_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: attach_instruction_image · Private data: prepare_meal_plan_import, commit_meal_plan_import, list_saved_recipes, list_saved_meal_plans, show_meal_plan, open_recipebee_kitchen, attach_instruction_image, update_recipe_content, show_recipe, attach_recipe_image, generate_recipe_image, get_recipe_image · Public sink: commit_meal_plan_import, attach_instruction_image, update_recipe_content, save_recipe · Destructive: remove_instruction_image, attach_recipe_image, generate_recipe_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
